messages:
alice: Quick ask — seeing intermittent 95th pct latency spikes in the batch8 benchmark (seq_len=512) on rtx-04. Can someone grab an nsys + torch profiler capture when you have a minute? I have a short reproducer.
bob: I can take this. Which command and where should I upload the artifacts?
alice: Thanks! Repro is `tools/bench --model=gpt-7b --batch 8 --seq 512 --iters 200` on the rtx-04 node. Capture both nsys and an in-process PyTorch profile. Example nsys command I usually use:

```
# on rtx-04
nsys profile --trace=cuda,cudnn,nvtx --sample=cpu --output=/tmp/nsys_3076543210 \
  --capture-range=nvtx --force-overwrite true \
  python -m tools.bench --model=gpt-7b --batch 8 --seq 512 --iters 200
```

And a minimal torch profiler snippet (in the runner):

```
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
                            record_shapes=True, profile_memory=True) as prof:
    run_one_iteration()
print(prof.key_averages().table(sort_by="cuda_time_total"))
prof.export_chrome_trace("/tmp/torchprof_3076543210.json")
```

carla: Quick checklist from me:
- capture full nsys QDREP + report (qdrep + sqlite + nvtx).
- export a condensed flamegraph (svg) and a chrome trace for the timeline.
- note run command, model commit hash, CUDA driver + GPU: `nvidia-smi` output.

Command to generate a flamegraph from nsys (one-liner):
```
nsys stats /tmp/nsys_3076543210.qdrep --report=flamegraph -o /tmp/flame_3076543210.svg
```

perf-bot: Please remember to redact any customer data and remove local absolute paths. Upload artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/3076543210/ and set ACL to perf-team-only. Do NOT include private keys or kube configs. :lock:
dave: Do we need kernel symbols / debug packages for useful stacks? Last time missing symbols made flamegraph noisy.
carla: Yes, kernel symbols help for CUDA driver frames. If you can, install `debuginfo` for the kernel and libcuda on the node, or at least collect uname -a and `cat /proc/version` and attach which driver package is installed. Set `NSYS_SYMBOL_DIR=/data/symbols` if we have symbol bundles.
erin: I can create the S3 prefix and pre-set perms. @bob — when you upload, ping me and I'll verify access. I can also run a quick post-process to strip env paths and gzip large files.
bob: Got it. I'll run capture now, upload to s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/3076543210/, ping @erin after. I'll include nsys qdrep, sqlite, torchprof json, flame svg, and a short metadata.txt containing `git rev`, `nvidia-smi`, `cuda toolkit`.
alice: Awesome, thanks everyone. If it's quick could you also attach a 10-20s sample flame svg so we can eyeball hotspots before full analysis? :thumbsup:
carla: Will do. If I see a KV-cache miss pattern I'll drop a quick note here with the trace offsets.
bob: Uploaded partials (flame svg + metadata) to the S3 path. Full qdrep up shortly. Pinged @erin for perms.
erin: Confirmed I can access the new prefix. Files look good. I'll gzip the qdrep after it's fully uploaded to save space.
alice: Perfect — leaving it to the perf triage team. Thanks all.
